notes: Corpus carries response_text and response_type for grounding. Top-5 per query is the recommended downstream K. Retrieval scores are NOT calibrated; treat them as ordinal.

corpus_limitation.note: Corpus is 50 documents — a smoke-test benchmark, not production scale. Recall@5 on test is 0.532, but this is dominated by corpus size. Downstream 06_agent must treat retrieved context as candidate evidence, not authoritative.
